answer: Re-attestations are stored in anchor and meadow lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the horizon graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1431 impostors cost 1542 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
